title: Telekinesis Power Secrets
author: Unknown
description: Telekinesis Power Secrets by Adrian P. Cooper, published by Mind Power Corporation (2006), the publisher of his Our Ultimate Reality. A short practical manual, it claims to teach telekinesis (psychokinesis), the moving or affecting of physical objects by the mind. After prerequisites, it works through chapters on relaxation, concentration and meditation as foundations, then exercises in creating 'psi balls' of energy, psychic shields, using the psi wheel (a paper spinner balanced on a needle), moving larger objects and bending metal, ending with a summary. Written in the popular New Age self-development genre and making no scientific case, it is best read as a document of contemporary psychic-training practice.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
